title: Handley Page Halifax NA612
memorial_details:
description: Heading:  IN MEMORY OF THE CREW OF HALIFAX BOMBER NA612 KILLED IN ACTION/ NEAR BRAFFERTON WHILE RETURING TO RAF DISHFORTH FROM A MISSION/ OVER GERMANY AT 0112 HOURS ON 4TH MARCH 1943.

Left column:  (names)/ EVERY MAN WAS A VOLUNTEER/ 55573 BOMBER COMMAND AIRCREW WERE KILLED DURING WORLD WAR II/ INCLUDING 9919 FROM CANADA/ THEY ARE REMEMBERED BY THE PEOPLE OF HELPERBY AND BRAFFERTON

RH column: (Background surrounding the loss of NA612)/ STRIKE HARD STRIKE SURE
